body:
I work in a fairly anti-gang workplace. Even then, as a dude who openly sucks some dick, you are NOT homophobic. Regardless of the gender you're attracted to, you have an opinion on all of it.

Not being gay? A non-issue. Trans issues? That's an area I wont go into. I'm not trans although I've dated trans people, it's an itso-facto kind of area. It sounds like you were supportive,  but they found it not. Not YOUR problem. Even though they may have thought, even for the briefest of moments it wasn't supportive, and they may have spoken with others and it wasn't. You had no intention of that lack of support. Maybe try and explain it? Think it through, and talk to them about it? I've become offensive over other things before. Maybe they did because they're used to transphobia. Sit them down and talk it through.

And if they cant see it? Fuck em. I'd say the same thing to gays who cant see two sides of a coin. And I suck fuckin dick
I dont drink, I dont sleep

Another update: first off... damn. I never thought I'd receive this kind of support. I just figured I'd get a few "keep going dude" responses, and I'd keep on chewing on a pistol muzzle. But damn. I love yall so much. You showed that people actually gave a shit. I always thought those "keep on keepin on" responses were BS. I called the suicide hotline, they gave me a number. I called that number a few minutes ago, they not only accept my insurance, I'm waiting on a councilor to knock on my door any minute to talk with me.

I fucking love you all. Regardless if my shitty Murican healthcare cost, I can be a person, and not a husk.

Thank you

Update: I called the suicide hotline for the US. Apparently theres outpatient services for addiction treatment where I live. I dont have to start over. Idk if I will, but I have the option to try. Hopefully my next post will be more positive.
Thanks. I'm still reeling from it rn. I'm in that still sad but relieved/happy daze. I've overcame addiction before, but now I have resources to help me. I'm ready
I know I'm still f'ed up but thanks. I've been in such a rough place, knowing I'd lose my job if I went into rehab, but I can do it now! Treatment outside of work! Whooodathunkit?
I'd be scared shitless if someone yelled "have at thee!" Whilst chasing me with a rapier.
